sections.label: Consumer (B2C)
sections.title: Straightforward answers for everyday use
sections.description: How the personal space works: check-ins, diary, exercises, progress and data protection.

items.question: What can I do in Dzvin.co?
answer: Track your stress, mood, energy and focus, keep a private diary, choose breathing and calming exercises, meditations and tips, set personal goals and review your progress. All at your own pace, with no mandatory steps.

items.question: How does the daily check-in work?
answer: The main check-in is four ratings on a 1 to 5 scale: stress, mood, energy and focus. If you are short on time, you can record only your mood. Missing a day has no consequences: there are no streaks or penalties.

items.question: What do I get after a check-in?
answer: The entry is saved in your history, and My Day and My Progress let you see changes over time and open a short exercise.
Some texts on My Day, such as the daily story, may be generated automatically. They are not professional advice or a conclusion about your state.

items.question: Is this a medical diagnosis?
answer: No. Dzvin.co is a self-support service. It does not diagnose, does not predict your state and does not replace a doctor or psychotherapist.
The psychological questionnaires in the app are meant for self-observation and are not a medical conclusion.

items.question: What should I do if I feel very bad right now?
answer: Dzvin.co is not designed for crisis situations. If your life or safety is at risk, call your local emergency number (112) immediately or reach out to a professional or someone you trust.

items.question: Who can see my entries and what are my data rights?
answer: Your check-ins and diary are available only to you after signing in. Employers and researchers have no access to them.
You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict and port your data. Self-service account deletion is not available in the app yet — you can send a request through the contacts page.

items.question: What should I do if I can't sign in or found a bug?

sections.label: Business (B2B)
sections.title: Answers for companies and HR
sections.description: What we offer organizations today and how data access boundaries work.

items.question: What can Dzvin.co offer a company today?
answer: Employees can use Dzvin.co personal self-support. Company tools with aggregated team indicators are in development and not launched yet, so we start working with companies through a pilot whose terms we agree individually.

items.question: Can employers see employees' personal entries?
answer: No. Private diaries and personal check-ins are not available to employers. Any company indicators are designed to be aggregated only and not to identify individual people.

items.question: Is this an employee monitoring tool?
answer: No. Dzvin.co is built to support people, not to control them. We do not assess individual employees' performance or report conclusions about their mental state to management.

items.question: Are there proven business results?
answer: Not yet. We do not claim reduced burnout, attrition or productivity effects. This is exactly what we plan to test honestly in pilots with indicators agreed in advance.

items.question: How do I discuss a pilot?

answer.linkSuffix: , briefly describing your team size and expectations, and we will propose a pilot format.

sections.label: Research (R&D)
sections.title: Answers for researchers and research institutions
sections.description: How we approach research partnerships, participant consent and ethics.

items.question: What research partnerships are you looking for?
answer: We are open to joint protocols with universities and research institutes in psychological well-being and decision support. A separate track is research into QDIP decision-support methods.

items.question: What data is used in research?
answer: Only data from participants who have given separate informed consent to a specific study, after ethics approval. Users' personal records are not used for research by default.

items.question: Does Dzvin.co predict mental state?
answer: No, the product contains no forecasts. Prediction and model evaluation are research hypotheses that require testing on separate, approved data. There are no independent results from such studies yet.
